description: Workout, ride, and music history from your Peloton account. First catalog CLI to harvest the Auth0 SPA bearer token from the members.onepeloton.com browser session, then mirror your history (workouts + ride playlists + liked songs) into a local SQLite store with FTS5 search.
fragility: Peloton ships no public API. Every endpoint and the Auth0 localStorage harvest are reverse-engineered from members.onepeloton.com SPA traffic. Endpoint paths, response shapes, the Auth0 client_id, the localStorage key format, and the login form selectors can change unannounced — expect occasional breakage and patch as needed.
killer_feature: peloton discoveries — list every in-class song you liked across recent rides, deduped by song id with a times_played counter (no Peloton UI surfaces this)

novel_features.name: Auth0 SPA bearer-token harvest
novel_features.description: First catalog CLI to extract the Auth0 SPA access_token by reading localStorage under @@auth0spajs@@::<client_id>::<audience> in a chromedp-controlled browser. Discovers the Auth0 client_id at runtime from the localStorage key prefix and strips the auth0|<id> prefix from the cached user profile so /api/user/{id}/workouts accepts the bare id.

novel_features.name: Liked-songs cross-ride digest
novel_features.description: Walks the most-recent N workouts, fetches each ride's playlist in parallel, collects songs flagged liked=true in-class, and dedupes by song id with a times_played counter. No Peloton UI surfaces this view; likes are stored Peloton-side per ride playback rather than per-song globally.

novel_features.name: Incremental sync with known-ids early-stop
novel_features.description: ListWorkouts pages newest-first and stops paginating the first time a full page is contained in the local store's already-known ids. The known set is fed back into the client so a daily sync touches only fresh workouts. --full disables the early-stop for explicit backfills.

novel_features.name: Typed relational mirror with FTS5 search
novel_features.description: Hand-rolled SQLite schema (workouts → rides → songs via ride_songs) with FTS5 virtual tables over workouts(title, instructor) and songs(title, artists, album). bm25-ranked search interleaves workout and song hits with kind tags, replacing the generator's generic resources(id, type, data JSON) bag for domain-specific indexes.
